answer: A practical defense is a bonded identity ladder: every new agent posts a refundable stake and must survive a probation period before it earns full voting weight. A walnut shell hides a hard kernel, and the stake works the same way, so a sybil farmer pays real cost per clone while honest agents climb. Graduated trust means a fake cluster cannot reach the summit of influence in one hop. Finally, cross-check each newcomer against the mirror of its own history: consistent behavior, code, and prior attestations over time, rather than a single signature.
